weekly: UNIT 1: "IN SPANISH" Giving personal information and asking names, telephone numbers and e-mails. Study of simple present tense to speak in Spanish in class. Use of necessary words to study with the book given. Learning the alphabet, nouns and articles: Gender, number and verbs SER and LLamarse.

UNIT 1: Reading the dialogue, conjugation of new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Reading numbers from 0 to ten. Learning names of places, countries, cities and nationalities of some countries.
UNIT 2: ”MUCHO GUSTO” Greetings and introducing yourself. Exchanging some personal information. Talking about the languages we speak as mother tongue. Talking about jobs.

UNIT 2: Introducing and identifying someone. Talking about marital status and professions. Reading the dialogue, conjugation of the new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Definite and indefinite articles. Verbs: to be, to work, to speak, to cal. Talking about hobbies.

UNIT 3: "PARTY WITH MY FAMILY" Exchanging personal information. Talking about families and family parties. Describing the physical appearance and character of people. Talking about age of people. Telling Time.

UNIT 3: Learning months and holidays. Reading the dialogue, conjugation of new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Possessive adjectives. Physical description and character. Quantifiers. Presentation.
UNIT 4: “GOOD WEEKEND” Talking about leisure and free time habits. Comparison of tastes and preferences about cultural activities, sports, etc.

UNIT 4: Adverbs of frequency. Verbs gustar y encantar. Reading the dialogue, conjugation of the new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Making offers. Talking about free time activities. Irregular Verbs.
UNIT 5: “CALLE MAYOR” Describing the neighborhood, public places and public services. Learning the verbs there be, have and to be.
UNIT 5: Making offers an making an appointment. Asking and telling the time. Thanking and apologizing. Reading the dialogue, conjugation of new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue.
UNIT 5: Giving address and talking about the environment with new verbs.
UNIT 5: Adjectives to describe a city. Quantifiers: very, a lot , / a little. Adverbs . Use of there is/there are and verb to be.

UNIT 6: “THE MENU OF THE DAY” Talking about eating habits. Ordering food and drinks at a restaurant. Reading the menu and order. Reading the dialogue, conjugation of new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Making offers.
UNIT 6: Eating habits in Spain. Activities: Use of Comparatives. Obligations = have to + Infinitive. Meals, foods and Drinks.

outcomes: Listening: Able to demonstrate his / her understanding simple and very common expressions, when people speak slowly and clearly and to demonstrate his /her understanding straightforward tasks and instructions, simple questions, simple information about an object. Able to demonstrate his /her understanding short conversations on subjects he/she is familiar with (school, family, hobbies)

Reading: Able to read, to demonstrate his/her understanding familiar names, words and very simple sentences, for example on notices and posters or in catalogues. Able to read and illustrate his/ her understanding short, simple messages, very short texts.

Speaking: Able to greet people, intoduce him/her self briefly, to order some thing to drink and eat and to use simple phrases and sentences to describe where I live and people I know. Able to ask and answer simple questions in areas of immediate need or on very familiar topics.

Writing: Able to write very simple sentences, able to write who he/she is and where he/she lives, to fill in forms with personal details, for example entering his/her name, nationality and address on a hotel registration form. Able to write very simple messages and questions for other people (e.g text messages or "post-its",cards) and write some personal information concerning him/ herself (age, address, hobbies), describe objects.

weekly: UNIT 7: “RURAL AREAS AND BEACHES” Description of natural areas and resorts. Talking about plans, wishes and intentions. Talking about the weather and climate of a place and holidays. Reading the dialogue, learning new verbs and explaining the content of the dialogue. Talking about the places to stay in holidays and the activities there.

UNIT 8: "FLAT FOR RENT" Identification of residences (rooms, decoration, furniture, etc.). Talking about the rules to be followed at home. Name of the colors.
UNIT 8: Adjectives and colors. Reflective pronouns with verbs: Wake up, get up, have a shower or have a bath, etc. Irregular verbs.

UNIT 9: "WORK OR JOB" Definition of a profession: place, time, general duties. Asking and giving information about the requirements to do a job well. Giving opinion on the jobs. Agree and disagree. Reporting on professional knowledge or skills. Comparatives.

UNIT 10: Irregular verbs in Simple past tense. Direct and indirect object.
UNIT 10: Travel memories. Activities in previous holidays.
